Palermo Buenos Aires' largest neighbourhood. Shop, drink, enjoy outdoor activities in the parks, or simply rest under a tree. Galileo Galilei Planetarium UFO-shaped planetarium built in the 1960s in one of the city's biggest areas of parkland.
